product.name: Inertia Modular Fusion Laser System
product.description: A 10 MJ, diode-pumped solid-state laser system designed to deliver approximately 1,000 beamlines at a 10 Hz repetition rate for inertial-confinement fusion power generation.

product.name: Mass-Manufactured Fusion Fuel Targets
product.description: Factory-produced inertial-fusion fuel targets containing a hohlraum, carbon shell, deuterium-tritium fuel, and supporting films, designed for high-rate laser fusion shots at a target cost below $1.

identifier.value: Laser Inertial Fusion Energy Power Plant

product.name: Laser Inertial Fusion Energy Power Plant
product.description: A planned grid-scale fusion power plant that uses high-energy lasers to ignite deuterium-tritium targets and convert fusion heat into dispatchable electricity and industrial process heat.
